summary: PWA + Push Notifications + Homepage Layout Redesign — Iteration 4 focused testing. All new push endpoints + PWA static assets + open-trip.id-style homepage layout verified. 13/13 new push+PWA backend tests pass. Full backend regression: 63/71 pass (same 8 pre-existing Karimunjawa-seat-exhaustion failures from iter 1–3, ZERO new regressions from push router addition). Frontend UI smoke: homepage hero tab switcher (Open Trip / Private Tur / Rental Gear / Komunitas) works correctly — placeholder text swaps per tab (Open Trip→'Cari trip: Labuan Bajo, Bromo, Derawan…', Rental→'Cari alat: tenda, carrier, sleeping bag…', Community→'Cari komunitas: Semeru, Rinjani…') AND search form submits to the correct target (rental tab → /rental?q=…, open-trip tab → /explore?q=…). All 8 homepage sections render in order: Trust stats (4 items), Destinasi wisata (4 cards from API — see note), Open Trip (5 cards), Rental Gear (4 cards), Private Tur (3 cards), Destinasi trending (4 cards), Travel Articles (3 cards), CTA banner (Diskon 5% TREXIO10). MyBookings page (logged in as traveler) shows the push opt-in card at top with 'Notifikasi push' heading + 'Aktifkan' button (data-testid=push-enable-btn). PWA: /manifest.json (200, short_name=TREXIO, theme_color=#1E3F20, both icon sizes), /service-worker.js (200, contains push+notificationclick handlers), /offline.html (200), /icon-192.png + /icon-512.png (200 image/png), /index.html contains manifest link + theme-color meta. GET /api/push/config returns {public_key, enabled:true}. POST /api/push/subscribe requires auth (401 anon), persists to db.push_subscriptions with upsert (2× calls same endpoint → single row). POST /api/push/test returns 400 when no subs (as spec says), returns 200 with sent/total when subs exist. POST /api/push/broadcast requires admin (401 anon, 403 traveler, 200 admin).

Not caused by iteration 4 push changes. Fix: either (a) reset seat count for this trip in seed, (b) point booking tests at a different trip index, or (c) add admin 'reset seats' endpoint.

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: /app/backend/routers/push.py is clean — upsert on (user_id, endpoint) prevents duplicate rows; /broadcast auto-cleans 404/410 dead subscriptions; /test correctly returns 400 when 0 subs; VAPID_PRIVATE/PUBLIC read from .env with sensible fallback to enabled=false.
GOOD: server.py includes push_router under /api prefix (line 43). CORS + startup seed unchanged. No regression risk.

GOOD: /app/frontend/src/lib/usePush.js correctly gates on serviceWorker + PushManager + Notification support, converts VAPID public key via urlBase64ToUint8Array, uses sub.toJSON() for backend payload — spec-correct.

GOOD: /app/frontend/public/service-worker.js referenced from index.js registration flow; PWA manifest links + apple-touch-icon + theme-color in index.html — all present and served with HTTP 200 via ingress.

GOOD: Home.jsx hero tab switcher is dynamic — tab state drives (1) placeholder text (open-trip / rental / community branches), (2) submit target via TABS[key].target with correct '?' vs '&' separator handling for the Private Tur case (target='/explore?category=Cultural' → '&q=…' appended). Verified via UI: rental → /rental?q=tenda, open-trip → /explore?q=bromo.
GOOD: /api/push/broadcast + /api/push/test both raise HTTP 503 when VAPID_PRIVATE is unset (fail-fast). Currently VAPID_PRIVATE is configured so enabled=true.
MINOR: PWAInstallPrompt.jsx only sets deferred on first fire of beforeinstallprompt; if the user dismisses (localStorage=1) they cannot re-enable install without clearing storage. Acceptable UX.

MINOR: usePush.enable() calls Notification.requestPermission() which is HTTPS + user-gesture-only. Card visibility on MyBookings gated by push.enabled (config.enabled from server), which is correct — but the card does NOT re-check permission state after enable(); toast success alone is authoritative. Fine for MVP.

MINOR: routers/push.py _send_one() returns False on any WebPushException and always adds to dead[] on 4xx/5xx — but only actually 410/404 truly means gone. Non-fatal (dead list is only used in /broadcast cleanup) but could leak short-term errors into deletions. Consider only deleting on 404/410 explicitly.
